pr.title: feat(dcp): TP-113 MCP catalog schema lint + CI step
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds `schemas/dcp/mcp_catalog.schema.json`: JSON Schema for `mcp_catalog.yaml`, including a `deprecated: {by, replacement, since}` field per design D-I.3.
- Adds `tests/dcp/test_mcp_catalog_lint.py`: validates live `mcp_catalog.yaml` against schema; asserts a fixture with a known drift class (referencing a removed server name) fails validation.
- Adds a CI step in `.github/workflows/ci-complete.yml` running the mcp-catalog-lint test.
- Ships hand-authored `proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-113/APPROVAL.json` per design B.6 (ci-complete.yml edit).

## Depends on
DMX-DCP-TOOLING-102 must be merged before this TP executes (ci-complete.yml serialization constraint).

## Scope
Schema + CI lint only. No runtime MCP wrapper changes.

## NOT_RUN
Full CI run, live MCP startup.

Inspect mcp_catalog.yaml to understand its current shape and identify a known drift class (e.g., a removed server name like mas-sequential-thinking referenced in config). Inspect ci-complete.yml to find the correct insertion point for the new lint step and verify no ci-complete.yml conflicts from TP-102.

Add a deprecated field to each server entry: object with required properties by (string: replacement server name), replacement (string), since (string: ISO date). additionalProperties: false where appropriate. Per design D-I.3 (TOOLING-0001 #3).
